baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two emphatic occurrences of latājidanna frame the paired superlatives asaddu and aqrabu around adāwa and mawadda.
baseline_models.mechanism: Repeated finding turns the ayah into an observable comparison: one relation is intensified hostility, while the other is nearness expressed as affection.

activation_trace.role: Finding or encountering supplies the ayah's empirical comparative frame.
Strength and hardness give the hostile pole its exceptional intensity.
Explicit enmity names the negative relation being ranked.
Nearness supplies the positive pole as reduced relational distance.
Affection specifies the quality in which nearness is measured.

changed_reading.before: A flat pair of statements assigning dislike and liking to named groups.
changed_reading.after: A forcefully predicted but observable relational spectrum, ranked by enacted hostility and affective proximity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The identity claim innā nasārā is followed by the causal dhālika bi-anna, the partitive minhum, priests, monks, and the refusal to act grandly.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah does not leave nearness resting on a label. It explains it through a subset containing learned and ascetic roles whose shared posture is non-self-exaltation.

activation_trace.role: Saying as professed belief makes innā nasārā an identity-position rather than the whole causal explanation.
The Christian affiliation branch supplies the named communal identity.
Priestly learned leadership supplies an internal interpretive role.
Ascetic worship from reverent fear supplies a second internal discipline.
The negated self-exaltation branch makes humility the shared operating posture.

changed_reading.before: Their Christian self-identification itself explains their greater affection.
changed_reading.after: The label locates the group, but the ayah causally filters the relation through a humble learned-ascetic subset within it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Both comparisons terminate in the repeated phrase li-lladhīna āmanū.
baseline_models.mechanism: The trust and security branch of faith makes the two ranked relations conditions around a believing community: one violates its security, while the other approaches it with affection.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling security and trust define the community toward which both relations are directed.
Boundary violation renders hostility as pressure against that security.
Reduced distance supplies a relation compatible with trust.
Affection gives that approach a positively disposed quality.

changed_reading.before: The ayah merely reports whom two groups like or dislike.
changed_reading.after: It maps how surrounding relations either violate or approach the trust-bearing space of those who believe.

context_deltas.mechanism: A prior verbal profession of faith coexists with concealed contrary entry and exit, while repeated seeing exposes harmful conduct; immediately after the focus, seeing exposes bodily overflow. The doubled finding in 5:82 therefore functions as a test of profession by visible trajectory.

activation_trace.role: The repeated act of finding anchors the focus as an observational judgment.
The branch of saying what is not so makes verbal profession an unreliable sign in this contrast.
Concealment supplies the hidden-state problem that observation must overcome.
Seeing with eye or insight makes rushing into transgression a publicly diagnostic sign.
Visible flowing abundance supplies the contrasting embodied sign after the focus.

structural_cues: 5:61 places qālū āmannā beside concealed contrary conduct.
The pre-focus tarā of 5:62 and 5:80 is answered by the post-focus tarā of 5:83.
The focus repeats emphatic latājidanna on both sides of its comparison.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies professions, concealment, repeated seeing, and visible overflow; I infer an epistemic rule that conduct verifies labels. The live alternative is that the visual verbs are rhetorical emphasis without a deliberate verification mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Those who say innā nasārā are nearest because the profession itself is accepted at face value.
changed_reading.after: The profession names a candidate relation, but the pericope teaches the reader to find its truth in observable conduct and embodied reception.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context twice marks failed internal restraint, once naming scriptural authorities and later mutual non-restraint. Against that failure, the focus's priests and monks matter as potential internal regulators only when joined to non-self-exaltation.

activation_trace.role: Failure to prohibit supplies the first missing communal brake.
The learned holder of scripture identifies an authority role that can fail its restraining task.
Mutual failure to restrain generalizes the institutional defect beyond one office.
Priestly learned leadership supplies the corresponding internal office in the positive relation.
Ascetic discipline adds a practice-oriented authority alongside learning.
Negated self-exaltation prevents these roles from hardening into self-protective rank.

structural_cues: 5:63 asks why learned authorities do not restrain sinful speech and consumption.
5:79 repeats the defect as failure to restrain one another.
5:82 uses bi-anna to make the listed roles and non-arrogance explanatory.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed restraining authorities and then humble learned-ascetic roles; I infer that internal moral mediation helps produce relational nearness. The alternative is that the offices merely identify a subgroup and that humility alone carries the causal weight.

changed_reading.before: Priests and monks are praised simply as revered offices.
changed_reading.after: Their relevance is functional and conditional: humble internal authority can inhibit the communal dynamics that otherwise mature into hostility.

context_deltas.mechanism: Rushing into transgression, repeatedly igniting war, requiring repeated extinguishing, and failing to restrain one another form a feedback system. The focus's strongest hostility is thus more than inward aversion: it is recurrent boundary-crossing that reproduces hostile action.

activation_trace.role: Exceptional force gives the focus relation system-level intensity.
Crossing the limit turns hostility into enacted violation.
Transgression appears as an activity into which people hasten.
Ignition supplies the recurring activation event of open conflict.
The branch of arousing enmity and anger names the fire's social function.
Extinguishing shows that the hostile process requires an opposing brake each time.
Absent mutual restraint removes an internal brake on repetition.

structural_cues: 5:64 uses kullamā for repeated ignition and extinguishing.
5:78 returns to habitual transgression before 5:79 names failed mutual restraint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies speed, crossing, recurrent ignition, extinguishing, and failed restraint; I supply the feedback arrow connecting them. They could instead be parallel examples of wrongdoing without one recursive mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Asaddu adāwatan means only the greatest degree of hostile feeling.
changed_reading.after: It can name the most forceful hostile ecology: repeated limit-crossing, conflict ignition, and inadequate internal inhibition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pericope repeatedly partitions named communities into moderated, righteous, and censured trajectories. The focus's minhum and explicit causal clause therefore locate a relationally near configuration within a named community rather than making communal identity an undifferentiated essence.

activation_trace.role: Moderation between extremes marks an explicitly differentiated community within a larger group.
Righteous action supplies a cross-category criterion opposed to corruption.
Association with God supplies a censured trajectory inside the same surrounding discussion of Christian claims.
Christian affiliation supplies the broad named category that the causal clause then differentiates.
The presence of learned worshippers specifies one internal relational affordance.
Non-exaltation supplies the disposition that actualizes that affordance.

structural_cues: 5:66 says minhum ummatun muqtasida and contrasts many others.
5:69 applies a conditional faith-and-action criterion across named categories.
5:72-73 criticizes specified propositions rather than erasing every internal distinction.
5:82 itself says minhum inside its causal explanation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated partitions and conditional criteria; I infer that 5:82's generalization is relational and internally differentiated. The alternative is that its comparative subject remains broadly categorical despite the later causal subset.

changed_reading.before: The ayah assigns one fixed relational essence to every member of each named community.
changed_reading.after: It compares broad social locations while explicitly explaining the nearer trajectory through a real but internal configuration of roles and humility.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after non-arrogance, heard revelation is understood, recognized as fixed truth, and visibly overflows as tears before verbal confession. This turns proximity in affection into receptive permeability: the near relation can be changed by what it receives.

activation_trace.role: Nearness supplies the low-distance condition for reception.
Affection gives the receptive relation a positive orientation.
Negated self-exaltation supplies the absence of egoic resistance.
Hearing as understanding and compliance begins the receptive sequence.
Delivery of what descends supplies the incoming content.
Easy abundant flow renders reception bodily visible.
The full-vessel image makes the tears an overflow from inward filling.
Recognition by a distinguishing trace supplies cognitive uptake.
Stable correspondence with reality identifies what has been recognized.

structural_cues: 5:83 follows 5:82 immediately with wa-idhā and an ordered reception-response sequence.
The sequence moves from hearing to recognition, bodily overflow, confession, and requested inscription among witnesses.
The final clause of 5:82 negates arrogance immediately before this sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered actions; I supply the arrow that humility lowers resistance and allows hearing to become recognition and overflow. The live alternative is that tears show strong affect without establishing humility as the enabling cause.

changed_reading.before: Mawadda is a comparatively warm but static sentiment.
changed_reading.after: Mawadda is enacted as humble permeability: an affective nearness capable of hearing, recognizing, overflowing, and publicly realigning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context repeatedly regulates taking others as awliyā, whereas the focus compares qurb and mawadda. Affective proximity can therefore be acknowledged without automatically settling questions of protective authority, governance, or allegiance.

activation_trace.role: Taking charge and standing over an affair gives wilāya a governance dimension.
Love, support, and alliance show that wilāya also overlaps the affective domain.
The repeated alliance construction keeps authority and affiliation under explicit evaluation.
Nearness names the comparison actually made in the focus.
Affection specifies that comparison without itself naming governance.

structural_cues: 5:57, 5:80, and 5:81 use the wilāya construction around explicit warnings.
5:82 changes vocabulary and syntax to a comparative finding of qurb in mawadda.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distinct constructions; I infer that comparative affection does not by itself authorize unqualified wilāya. Because the wilāya branch includes love and support, the distinction is functional rather than an absolute lexical wall.

changed_reading.before: Being nearest in affection amounts to an unrestricted directive of alliance.
changed_reading.after: The ayah recognizes comparative affective openness while leaving protective authority and allegiance subject to the context's separate tests.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it links form-distant water branches of qurb and nasr to the literal tear and river sequence. It remains anchored in aqrabahum, nasārā, and the immediate overflow after 5:82, but downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for receptivity, not as the lexical meaning of the communal labels.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Aqrabahum, nasārā, and non-arrogance immediately precede eyes overflowing with tears and the later rivers.

activation_trace.role: The water-vessel branch lets nearness carry an exploratory image of receptive containment.
Rain as relief turns aid into a life-giving inflow within the analogy.
Channels arriving from afar and joining collected water supply a network image for approach.
Abundant easy flow makes the receptive network visible as overflow.
A vessel filling until it spills supplies the analogy's internal pressure.
The literal flowing river gives the material sequence its downstream culmination.

changed_reading.before: Nearness in affection is only an inward emotion.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it behaves like a low-resistance watershed: aid arrives, receptive capacity fills, truth overflows, and the flow continues.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The tracking and night-listening branch of q-s-s is form-distant from the title qissīs, so this cannot redefine the office etymologically. It remains worth carrying because qissīsīn, ruhbānan, non-arrogance, and immediate hearing-recognition are explicit anchors; render it as a lexical echo of disciplined attentiveness.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The qissīsīn and ruhbānan clause culminates in non-arrogance, then 5:83 opens with hearing and recognition.

activation_trace.role: Tracking, seeking, and listening at night supply an exploratory image of sustained attention.
Fear with contraction supplies reverent restraint rather than expansive self-assertion.
Negated self-exaltation keeps attention from being blocked by rank.
Hearing as understanding and compliance realizes the attentional disposition.
Recognition by sign gives disciplined listening a cognitive result.

changed_reading.before: The named religious offices function only as static social titles.
changed_reading.after: As a contained lexical echo, they can evoke a discipline of seeking, reverent contraction, listening, and recognition that helps produce nearness.

strongest_changes: The doubled finding is verified by visible conduct rather than profession alone.
Humble learned-ascetic authority functions as a possible internal brake on recursive hostility.
The pericope makes communal categories internally differentiated rather than relationally essential.
The immediate hearing-recognition-overflow sequence turns mawadda into receptive permeability.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sits at a sharp observational hinge: repeated pre-focus seeing exposes transgression and failed restraint, while post-focus seeing exposes tears, recognition, confession, and realignment.
remaining_uncertainties: The offices may identify a subgroup without themselves supplying the restraining mechanism.
Qurb and mawadda are not fully separable from wilāya because wilāya also includes love and support.
The hydraulic and night-listening readings are branch-backed analogies, not direct lexical glosses.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Social distance is produced by posture, not label alone.** `ع د و B003` is enmity, `ق ر ب B001` nearness, `و د د B001` affection, and `ك ب ر B006` self-magnification. The paired superlatives are causally explained by learned devotion and absence of pride. I infer that humility shortens relational distance, while intensified hostility hardens it.
2. **Awe that recoils from self-magnification enables approach.** `ر ه ب B001` is fear with recoil and `B003` devotion from awe. I infer that inward recoil from one's own greatness opens outward proximity to believers.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later ayah 5:120 made the fixed ayah's local distinctions newly visible as bounded operations within a single encompassing dominion, rather than as an isolated rule or episode.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Relational nearness is causally tied to non-self-magnification.** Fixed **ق ر ب / B001** (“nearness as the opposite of distance”) locates affection, while fixed **ك ب ر / B006** (“grandeur and self-magnification”) is negated as part of the explanation. 5:80–5:81 treated alliance as a directional relation; 5:83 shows this nearer group hearing, recognizing, and visibly overflowing. I infer that humility lowers resistance to another community’s truth-claim and permits affective distance to close. “Nearest in affection” therefore reads as a produced proximity grounded in receptive social roles and posture, not an unexplained group essence.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 5:83 visibly enacted the proposed causal link: non-self-magnification was followed by hearing that crossed into recognition and overflow.

يدخل فيه وجد في الغضب، والموجدة من الغضب أو على الرجل، والوجدان إذا نص المصدر أنه في الغضب.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi güç, katılık, yüreklilik ve dayanıklılığı dalın çekirdeği olarak destekler; çetin zaman, kıtlık, eziyet, artırma, güç yetirme ve çaba harcama kullanımlarını da ayrıca verir. Dal korunabilir, ancak bu yapıya bağlı kullanımlar yalın güç anlamıyla özdeşleştirilmemelidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel güç, katılık ve çetinlik anlamları ile yalnız belirli biçim ve söz öbeklerinde görülen artırma, güç yetirme ve çaba kullanımları ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlıkta bedensel güç, katılık, dayanıklılık ya da yürek sağlamlığı olarak görülen yüksek yoğunluk; durumlarda ise çetinlik, kıtlık ve eziyetin ağırlığıdır. Aynı kökten gelen sınırlı yapılarda bir şeyi hafifletmenin karşıtı olarak artırma, bir işe gücü yetme ya da yetmeme, bütün gücünü harcama ve güçlü bir bineğe sahip olma anlatılır.

facets.statement: Bir beden, nesne ya da kişi güçlü, katı, dayanıklı, yürekli ve sarsılmaz olarak nitelenir.
Bir zaman, açlık ya da eziyet ağır ve katlanılması güç bir durum olarak anlatılır.
Belirli bir ad, hafifletmenin karşıtı olan artırma ve ağırlaştırma işlemini bildirir.
Karşıt iki eylemi yapamama kalıbı, kişinin hiçbir şeye gücünün yetmediğini bildirir.
Şarkı söyleyen kişinin sesini yükseltirken bütün gücünü harcaması anlatılır.
Bir kişinin ya da topluluğun güçlü bir bineğe veya güçlü binekler topluluğuna sahip olması anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek, bedende, nesnede veya kişilikte güç, katılık ve dayanıklılıktır; ağır zaman, açlık ve eziyet bu yoğunluğun durumlara uzanmasıdır. Ayrıca hafifletmenin karşıtı olan artırma, güç yetirememeyi bildiren kalıp, var gücüyle ses çıkarma ve güçlü bineğe sahip olma gibi sınırlı kullanımlar aktarılır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın varlıklardaki güç ve katılık çekirdeğiyle durumların ağır ve çetin oluşunu birlikte anlatmak gerektiğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hem güçlü ve dayanıklı niteliği hem de durumlara taşınan ağırlık ve çetinliği korur.

branches.branch_image_ar: إيناس الشيء برؤية أو إحساس أو سماع
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه آنس الشيء إذا أبصره أو رآه، وآنس الصوت إذا سمعه، وأحس الفزع أو وجد الشيء في نفسه، والاستئناس بمعنى النظر والتبصر.
يدخل فيه أنس الإنسان بالشيء أو بفلان، المؤانسة والتأنيس، الأنيس وكل ما يؤنس به، الفرح بالقرب والحديث، والحيوان الأنوس غير العقور.
يدخل فيه إنسي الدابة والقوس وكل شيئين: ما يلي الإنسان أو يقبل على الراكب أو الرامي، في مقابلة الوحشي.

branches.branch_image_ar: إنسان العين وصورة الإنسان في السواد
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه إنسان العين: المثال أو الصبي الذي يرى في سواد العين، وما ألحقه تهذيب اللغة من الأنملة أو إنسان الكف.
يدخل فيه كيف ابن إنسك للسؤال عن النفس، وفلان ابن أنس فلان لصفيه وخاصته، وما قاربه من الخدن والأنيس والخلص والجليس.
يدخل فيه تفسير حتى تستأنسوا بالاستئذان أو السلام وطلب الدخول، أو بإيجاد إيناس قبل الدخول.

Ayrıca insana dönük yan, gözde görülen küçük görüntü, kişinin kendisi veya seçilmiş yakını ve eve girişten önce kabul arama gibi belirgin biçimde ayrılmış kullanımları vardır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, uygun görülen sınırı ya da hakkı aşmayı açık haksızlıkla birleştirir; haksız saldırı ve baskın da bu çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ortak sınır aşma çekirdeğini verir; birine saldırma ve baskın yapma anlamlarını yalnızca kendi kullanım kalıplarına bağlı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Uyulması gereken sınırı ya da başkasının hakkını haksız biçimde aşmaktır. Birine saldırmak, malını almak, onu vurmak veya baskın yapmak bu aşmanın özel görünümleri olabilir.

facets.statement: Uyulması gereken sınırı veya başkasının hakkını aşarak açıkça haksızlık etme.
Haksız saldırı, vurma, mal alma ya da baskın yoluyla bu sınır aşımını gerçekleştirme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği, kişinin durması gereken sınırı geçmesi ve bunu başkasının hakkını çiğneyen açık bir haksızlığa dönüştürmesidir; saldırı ve baskın bu kapsamda yer alır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه عاد ورجع، والعودة، والعود بعد البدء، والمعاودة، والإعادة، واستعادة الشيء، وتعاود القوم، وعودة الحمى والمسألة، وصيغة عواد وعد، والعوادة من الطعام المعاد.
يدخل فيه المعاد بمعنى المصير والمرجع، والزمان أو المكان الذي يعود إليه، ومعاد الحاج، ومعاد مكة أو الآخرة والجنة في نقل المصادر.
يدخل فيه قولهم ما يبدئ وما يعيد أو لا يبدي ولا يعيد بمعنى لا يتكلم ببادئة ولا عائدة.
يدخل فيه العادة، والاعتياد، والتعود، والدربة حتى تصير سجية، والمواظبة، ومعاودة الحرب، والفحل المعتاد للضراب، والمطيق للشيء لأنه اعتاده.
يدخل فيه عيادة المريض، وعواد المريض، والمعادة في المصيبة أو المأتم التي يغشاها الناس، وما يرجع فيه الزائر مرة بعد مرة.
يدخل فيه العائدة، والمعروف والصلة والفضل، وما عاد على الإنسان بنفع أو رفق أو عطف، وقولهم هذا أعود عليك.
يدخل فيه العيد، والأعياد، وكل يوم مجمع أو يوم سرور، وما يعاود الإنسان من هم أو حب أو حال، وشهود العيد.
يدخل فيه العود من الإبل، والبعير أو الجمل المسن، والناقة أو الشاة أو الفرس في نقل بعض العرب، وما بلغ وقت السن بعد البزول، والاستعارة في الاستعانة بأهل السن والمعرفة.
يدخل فيه الطريق القديم أو العادي، والسؤدد العود، والرحم العود أو العودة بمعنى القديمة، وكل قدم صرحت به المصادر في هذا اللفظ.
يدخل فيه العود من الخشب، وكل خشبة أو خشبة دقيقة في نقل مقاييس، وعود التبخر، والعود الذي يضرب به أو المزهر المعروف.
يدخل فيه العود في الظهار، سواء فسر بتكرار القول، أو الجماع بعد الظهار، أو إمساك المرأة، أو فعل ما حلف ألا يفعله بحسب الأقوال المنقولة.
يدخل فيه عاد القبيلة، والنسبة عادي بمعنى قديم منسوب إلى عاد، واسم عادياء، والإبل العيدية المنسوبة إلى فحل أو إلى عاد بحسب النقل.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali yalniz korkunun kalkmasi olarak degil, kalbin yatismasi, guven verme, guvenilirlik, emanet edilen sey, guvenli yer ve dayanilir nitelik alanlariyla birlikte verir. Bu nedenle dalin cercevesi, guvenlik ve guvenilirlik ekseninde hem yalın hem de yapimli ve baglamli kullanislari ayirt ederek korunabilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalin guven ve korkusuzluk anlamlari ile belirli yapimli ya da soz obegi kullanislari birlikte vardir; tanim bunlari tek bir dar kaliba indirgemez.

concept_map.definition: Korkunun kalkmasiyla kalbin yatismasi, birine guven verilmesi veya bir kimsenin ya da seyin guvenilir kabul edilmesidir. Bu alan guvenli yer, emanet edilen sey, kendisine guvenilen kisi ve dayanilir binek gibi bagimli uygulamalari da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek korkuya karsi guven, ic yatiskinligi ve tehlikeden emin olma halidir.
Guven verme, birini kendi koruma ve teminat alani icine alma olarak kullanilir.
Guvenilirlik, ihanete karsi sadakat, emanet edilen sey ve kendisine guvenilen kisi anlamlarini dogurur.
Guvenin bulundugu yer, bir kimsenin emniyet icinde oldugu mesken veya siginak olarak adlandirilir.
Dayanikli ve aksamasindan korkulmayan deve kullanimi, guvenilirlik niteligini canli bir ornege uygular.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak bu dali korkunun ziddi olan guven, kalbin yatismasi ve guven verme alaninda toplar. Ayni iddia guvenilir kisi, emanet, guvenli yer ve dayanilir binek gibi turemis ya da baglamli kullanislari da cekirdege baglar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesindeki ortak alan tapınma ve keşişçe yaşama biçimidir. Korkunun kişiyi tapınmaya yöneltmesi, tek başına bir hücrede yaşama ve ölçüyü aşan tapınma yükü ise yalnız belirli açıklamalarda ve biçimlerde görülür.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın olarak korkudan doğan tapınma alanını tanımlar; belirli kişi ve yaşam biçimleri bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel biçimlerdir.

concept_map.definition: Kendini tapınmaya verme veya keşişçe bir yaşam sürme durumudur. Bazı açıklamalarda korku bu yönelişin nedeni olur; hücre hayatı ve ölçüyü aşan tapınma yükleri de belirli biçimlere bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Kendini tapınmaya verme veya keşişçe bir yaşam sürme durumudur.

Belirli bir keşişlik biçiminde kişi olağan ölçünün üzerinde tapınma yükü ve çile üstlenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar tapınma ve keşişlik alanında birleşir. Korkunun bu yaşayışa yöneltmesi, hücre hayatı ve olağan ölçüyü aşan tapınma yükü ise kaynaklardaki ayrı ve belirli vurgulardır.
